name: SDF-based Voxel Carving
definition: A technique to carve voxels from a 3D Gaussian Splatting scene by rendering an axis-aligned box Signed Distance Field (SDF) with zero opacity. It acts as a visual mask that hides splat samples inside the box while leaving samples outside unchanged, avoiding the thinning artifacts caused by deleting whole splats.
summary: SDF-based Voxel Carving masks 3D Gaussian Splatting samples within a box using a Signed Distance Field, avoiding thinning artifacts by hiding individual samples rather than deleting whole splats.
